notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
- Added a new spawning option to spawn layouts, Line Spawns. 

Line spawns are exactly as they sound, a thin line that the target can spawn at any point along, when using line spawns with any movement activated the target will only move between the two end points of the line.

- Added an Anti-Aliasing option dropdown to the Display Settings menu

- Fixed the page controls for online routines

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
-Added a new spawning option to spawn layouts, Point Spawns. These new spawns will allow a target to be spawned in the same pinpoint location, if used with movement enabled the target will remain stationary. 

-Added a firing mode toggle to Tracking training to allow switching between single and automatic firing

-Added a HP option to Reflex

-Movement can now be completely disabled in Tracking mode

-Targets now have outlines to help distinguish the target spawn order and which target will be hit first

-Adjusted some UI elements for clarity

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:

notes.title: Scoring Update
notes.notes:
Scoring has been adjusted to prevent some inconsistencies. This may cause a bit of the stir in the leaderboards, but it will be worth it for the consistency in the long run.

A basic breakdown overlay has also been added which you can reveal by hovering over the question mark that has been been added to the end of round scoreboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/c89997048d2ecfa7f918601a34328911f74fa951.png[/img]

notes.title: Online Leaderboards & Community Workshop
notes.notes:
You can now play community created routines with custom leaderboards included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/ae4c2df8d8a9cf46489405d179d7823ff3afaa52.png[/img]

Any routine uploaded will automatically receive its own online Steam leaderboard to compete on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/c8195ba705feee5809e4ceed4b85162c8f758334.png[/img]

You can also download community routines and copy their layouts and presets to make your own custom routines.

Along with this update are ongoing UI changes to make navigating the game much simpler and easier, so expect changes to the UI in multiple minor patches over the coming weeks.

If you have any issues or requests be sure to drop them in a thread in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1421020/discussions/]Community Discussion [/url]board.

notes.title: New training setting and some fixes
notes.notes:
-Minor UI fixes

-Added Spawning Mode setting to Reflex and Tracking training. You can now switch between spawning targets on timed intervals, or instantly respawning targets on kill. There are 2 sub-options, respawn on kill for each target, or respawn on kill for all targets; which will respawn the whole group of targets when the screen is cleared.

-Fixed issue where Tracking Mode targets may spawn overlapping an older target, making the older target unhittable. Target hit priorities are now sorted by spawn order, you will always hit the oldest target when two or more targets overlap

[i]
If you have any issues or requests be sure to drop them in a thread in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1421020/discussions/]Community Discussion [/url]board.[/i]

notes.title: Routines Update
notes.notes:
Today's update brings Routines, a way to create your own challenges and track your hi-scores.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/5e3fd6c95624931bd71d6cff0898ff86d14a31c4.png[/img]

Previously, since presets and spawn layouts could be interchanged freely, comparing scores from one round to another made no real sense, having a different spawn layout from the previous round with the same training settings would essentially render any score comparisons meaningless.

Now, there are routines. Creating your own routine is simple, just pair up any of your saved presets and spawn layouts to combine and make up to 10 rounds in a routine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/c816e68efa7c0342c997b2cd72849cd45fba195b.png[/img]

Use your routines to keep track of individual hi-scores for each round, as well as an overall hi-score for your best attempt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789158/b89cd14b4c4aa2a3190b3b0dc6e9a6f06eef9d74.png[/img]

In the coming updates there will be workshop integration for custom made routines as well as online leaderboards.
